// Wiring: STEP -> pin 3, DIR -> pin 2, EN -> pin 4 (LOW = enabled),
//         driver VMOT to the motor supply (12-24 V, 100 uF across it), GND shared.
// Set the driver's current limit (Vref) for your motor before running it.
// Steps per turn = 200 (a 1.8 degree motor) x microsteps (MS pins / driver default).

const int dirPin = 2;
const int enablePin = 4;
const long stepsPerTurn = 200L * 8;   // 1/8 microstepping

AccelStepper stepper(AccelStepper::DRIVER, stepPin, dirPin);

  pinMode(enablePin, OUTPUT);

  stepper.setAcceleration(1000);      // steps per second per second
  stepper.moveTo(stepsPerTurn);
}

void loop() {
  if (stepper.distanceToGo() == 0) {

  stepper.run();   // call as often as possible: never delay() here
}

q: Write a Structured Text PLC program for a tank: open the fill valve when the low float switch comes on, and close it when the high float switch comes on.
reply:
<title>
ST: tank sequence (CASE state machine) (Structured Text (PLC)) — Fill, settle and drain phases with a phase timer and a fill alarm.
</title>
PROGRAM TankSequence
VAR
    LowFloat AT %IX0.0 : BOOL;    (* TRUE: water at the low mark *)
    HighFloat AT %IX0.1 : BOOL;   (* TRUE: water at the high mark *)
    FillValve AT %QX0.0 : BOOL;
    DrainPump AT %QX0.1 : BOOL;
    FillAlarm AT %QX0.2 : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR
    Phase : INT := 0;              (* 0 idle, 10 filling, 20 settling, 30 draining, 99 alarm *)
    InPhase : TON;
    LastPhase : INT := -1;
END_VAR

(* the phase timer restarts whenever the phase changes *)
InPhase(IN := (Phase = LastPhase), PT := T#2m);
LastPhase := Phase;

CASE Phase OF
    0:  IF LowFloat THEN Phase := 10; END_IF;
    10: IF HighFloat THEN Phase := 20;
        ELSIF InPhase.Q THEN Phase := 99;      (* filling took over 2 minutes *)
        END_IF;
    20: IF InPhase.ET >= T#10s THEN Phase := 30; END_IF;
    30: IF LowFloat THEN Phase := 0; END_IF;
    99: Phase := 99;                         (* stays here until the PLC is reset *)
END_CASE;

FillValve := (Phase = 10);
DrainPump := (Phase = 30);
FillAlarm := (Phase = 99);
END_PROGRAM
>>>
